paras.text: Neo Frame Jumping Hour
Vintage inspiration meets modern ingenuity in the new Neo Frame Jumping Hour.
Royal Oak Offshore Diver
This sporty 42 mm reference pairs a deep teal dial with pink gold accents, showcasing the collection’s commitment to creative expression and technical performance.
Royal Oak Offshore Selfwinding Chronograph

This 37 mm titanium Royal Oak Offshore, framed by a diamond‑set bezel, is powered by Calibre 6401, the Manufacture’s latest integrated selfwinding chronograph movement, blending sporty codes with a refined pink aesthetic.
Royal Oak Offshore Selfwinding Chronograph
Presented in stainless steel, this sporty wristwatch brings a vibrant edge to the collection's powerful design through energetic orange accents.
Royal Oak Concept Flying Tourbillon
Created in collaboration with Yoon and Verbal, this Royal Oak Concept Flying Tourbillon brings bold minimalism into a compact 38.5 mm titanium case.
Établisseurs Galets
A sculptural timepiece inspired by the water-polished stones of the Vallée de Joux, shaped around the hand‑finished Calibre 3098.
150 Heritage Ultra-complication Universal Calendar
This ultra-complicated pocket watch stands as a tribute to rare métiers d’art and the enduring spirit of craftsmanship.
Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Selfwinding Flying Tourbillon
Showcasing an ethereal flying tourbillon, this complication combines technical sophistication with contemporary contrast.
Royal Oak Selfwinding Perpetual Calendar
Combining refined aesthetics with technical mastery, this 41 mm Perpetual Calendar is crafted entirely in “Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50” ceramic and powered by Calibre 7138.
Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph
Adorned with brilliant-cut diamonds, the bezel of this 38 mm Chronograph adds a dazzling accent to a technical milestone, the new Calibre 6401.

headings.html:
Musée Atelier
Audemars Piguet

Watchmaking
Experiences

paras.text: Experience our heritage, craftsmanship and connection to the world in the Musée Atelier Audemars Piguet which pays tribute to the craftspeople who have made what Audemars Piguet is today, generation after generation.

Discover the fascinating universe of Haute Horlogerie through hands‑on experiences that reveal the expertise Audemars Piguet has honed for generations. Register for an upcoming masterclass and enjoy an immersive watchmaking experience.
